Essential Anesthesia Management is looking for a service-oriented CRNA to join our team at CHRISTUS Santa Rosa Westover Hills in San Antonio, Texas . This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a growing, collaborative anesthesia practice offering a diverse case mix and a chance to work at the top of your license.
Position Highlights:
$350,000 1099 (based on 46 weeks of coverage)
6 Weeks Off – time off coordinated with the team
Diverse case mix at a multi-specialty hospital
Perform your own regional and neuraxial blocks – training available for those looking to expand their skill set!
CRNA On-Call team of 7 covering OR and backup OB during the day
Anesthesiologist primary call at night and weekends, with CRNAs as backup if needed
Optional extra income opportunities covering 8-hour shifts on weekends at Westover Hills or other San Antonio facilities
Contractor Perks:
Paid Medical Malpractice (including tail coverage)
Access to group health, dental, life, and disability plans through preferred partnerships
Supportive, collaborative environment where CRNAs can advance their skills and autonomy
Qualifications:
New graduates and experienced CRNAs welcome!
Interest in practicing full-scope anesthesia and expanding regional/neuraxial experience

About Us:
Essential Anesthesia Management, a partnership between YPS and EmergencHealth, is a clinician-founded, clinician-led anesthesia management company striving to deliver the highest quality anesthesia care to both patients and hospitals alike. Over the past several years, we have experienced significant growth, providing turn-key department management at over 125 facilities in 6 states. Over 1400 CRNA and Anesthesiologist providers make up the Essential Team. We are continually seeking additional service-minded professionals to join our team and pride ourselves on hiring the best and brightest.  We want to hire exceptional people.
